title: Attention of a Kiss: Generative Video Attention Maps as Explainable and Creative Material
abstract: arXiv:2509.05323v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents an artistic and technical investigation into the attention mechanisms of video diffusion transformers. Inspired by early video artists who manipulated analog video signals to create new visual aesthetics, this study proposes a method for extracting and visualizing cross-attention maps in generative video models. Built on the open-source Wan model, our tool provides an interpretable window into the temporal and spatial behavior of attention in text-to-video generation. Through exploratory probes and a series of artistic case studies, we examine the potential of attention maps as both analytical tools and raw artistic material. This work contributes to the growing field of Explainable AI for the Arts (XAIxArts), inviting artists to reclaim the inner workings of AI as a creative medium.

translated_title: 一个吻的注意力：生成式视频注意力图作为可解释与创作性材料
translated_abstract: 本文对视频扩散Transformer的注意力机制进行了艺术性与技术性的双重探索。受早期视频艺术家通过操纵模拟视频信号创造新视觉美学的启发，本研究提出了一种在生成式视频模型中提取和可视化交叉注意力图的方法。该工具基于开源的Wan模型构建，为文本到视频生成中注意力的时间与空间行为提供了一个可解释的窗口。通过探索性探测和一系列艺术案例研究，我们考察了注意力图作为分析工具和原始艺术材料的双重潜力。这项工作为不断发展的艺术领域可解释AI（XAIxArts）做出了贡献，邀请艺术家将AI的内部运作机制重新夺回，作为一种创作媒介。
tldr: 本文基于开源Wan模型提出了一种交叉注意力图提取与可视化工具，将生成式视频模型的注意力机制既作为可解释的分析工具，也作为可供艺术家创作的原始材料，推动了艺术领域可解释AI（XAIxArts）的发展。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tool built on the open-source Wan model for extracting and visualizing cross-attention maps in generative video models, positioning attention maps as both explainable analytical tools and raw creative material for artists, contributing to the field of Explainable AI for the Arts (XAIxArts).
